message.content: All three probe results are in: the exhaustive FP16 sweep shows max error 1.30e-6 > 1e-6 (confirming c1, worst at x=3378, u near the reduction region), c2 also shows 1.30e-6 at x=3378 (same root cause, error at 65504 only 1.4e-7), and c3 stays under tolerance at 8.58e-7 near -1/subnormals. I'll finalize evidence for all three claims.
